product.name: Monoprice 3 Meter (10ft) Dual 1/4in TS Male Instrument Cable
product.description: Connect your keyboard, drum machine, or other two-channel output device to your mixer using this Dual 1/4" TS Male Instrument Cable from Monoprice™!This cable is constructed with two 26 AWG conductors and copper braid shielding. It has a pair of 1/4" TS male plugs at each end, making it suitable for use with keyboards, drum machines, and instruments with 2-channel output. It is also useful as a patch cord on your mixer. The two 1/4" connectors at each end are color coded gray and red and feature knurled grips so you can insert and extract the plugs with ease.Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
